observations: Slow conditional counts, squares, W2, H and half-life2048 remain independent of the fast stream.
Fast increment occurs after next ordinal dedup; current miss is not a sample. Common monotone q* is max(current probe count,next sample ordinal).
Lazy per-ID probability is multiplied by an O(K) marginal scale. All partitions use the same normalization, with no resident-only renormalization.
Parent BUILD/scan/cycle guards, action construction/pruning and finalized intent recording are unchanged in diff.
Fixed prior64 has more relative influence at shorter half-life; this is not a pure time-constant ablation.

Producer tests cover direct formula/nonnegativity/global and operator sums, conditional independence, duplicates/current miss/q+1 clocks, zero observations/K1/P1/longgap/epoch wrap, switch/reversal, test-only2048 identity, inherited guard tests and400callback legality. Tests were inspected, not rerun.
limits: An empty stream means zero observations with positive K/P; official legal inputs require positive dimensions.
400-step legality test is not action equivalence to parent, nor proof of improved costs.
Normalization proof assumes valid finite raw count state; normal accepted stream and decay keep that state bounded.
